conclusion: No fixed all-race strategy achieved positive ROI. Human-defined ticket shapes can be benchmarked cleanly, but buying every race at flat 100-yen stake is unprofitable.
interpretation: Highest pooled ROI among the six was Q_TOP2_TO8 at 75.05%, but it used about 11.9 tickets per race.
Q_AXIS1_TOP6 was nearly the same ROI at 74.81% with only about 5 tickets per race and much lower drawdown, making it the most efficient simple quinella baseline.
Q_TOP6_BOX maximized hit rate at 63.83% but point cost pushed ROI down to 70.63%.
No trio strategy exceeded 71% pooled ROI.
Do not interpret higher hit rate as profitability; ticket count dominates cost.
